segment.source: <end>
$(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName)? Oldfield speaking. Over.<end>
I hear you loud and clear, Professor. Over.<end>

Excellent. I have work for you. We've been looking through some data in the Keep, or as we now know it as the Arch Island Keep, and have uncovered the locations of a couple of facilities I'd like you to investigate.<end>

The first one is the Nexus of Technology, a research facility located at coordinates K7. It should be your primary target for now, as we believe that, in addition to any potential technology we might uncover, it contains invaluable information regarding the other facilities and Lemurian history.<end>

Yes, Lemuria - this is the name NFT gave to this project as well as the whole region itself.
Lemuria... But more on that later.<end>
Gee, Professor, you've been really busy down there.<end>
By the caverns, Arch Island Keep is a genuine gold mine of ancient history. In all honesty, if I don't get a heart attack now from all the excitement I don't think I ever will.<end>
Regardless, besides <end>

Nexus of Technology, there is another location we have info on - Crimson Meadow Horticulture Center, located in H7; it's that misty red shore north-east of our camp. All of these red plants seem to originate from there. But be warned: Chief told me his sec-troopers encountered dangerous insectoid creatures over there.<end>

$(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName), there is one more important piece of information I need to give you. All of these coordinates came from a dispatching console found in Arch Island Keep. On it we found traffic logs between Arch Island Keep and these other locations; each of these has marked coordinates. Other facilities must have them as well, so if you find them in working condition, get us those coordinates. It will help us immensely.<end>
That is all. Best of luck, $(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName). Contact me over the navcom or in person once you've uncovered something. Oldfield out.<end>
Will do. Out.<end>
::You look at the navcom device.::<end>
<end>
::Select channel.::<end>
::Select channel::<end>
<end>
::Channel 1 (Marcus)::<end>
<end>
::Static.::<end>
<end>
Yes? ::You hear gunfire in the background.::<end>
What's your status? Over.<end>
<end>

What th--?
It's you.<end>
::Static.::<end>
<end>
::Put the device back in your pocket.::<end>
Good for the time being. Over. ::Gunfire continues.::<end>
<end>
Roger. Hang in there. $(context.player.Name) out.<end>
Our numbers are getting low, but we're still alive and kicking. Over. ::Gunfire continues.::<end>
$(context.player.Name) out.<end>
You are all going to die.<end>
<end>
::Say nothing.::<end>
There's no need to use the navcom, $(context.player.Name), I'm right here. Out.<end>
Marcus here. Over.<end>
<end>
Hey, Marky.<end>
Goodbye, $(context.player.Name). <end>
::Static.::<end>
I found some old naval mines we could deploy around the island, over.<end>
<end>
Naval mines? Where?<end>
At J1. They appear to be in good condition. I just need you to send someone to pick them up, over.<end>
We don't have any sec-troopers left to spare. <end>
Especially considering they'd have to go through pirate territory. <end>
Over.<end>
What do you propose I do, over?<end>

Uh, perhaps there is some other way...
<end>
We haven't seen him in a while, but maybe that old ferryman would be willing to help you.<end>
He's been uncooperative so far, but who knows. That's all I could think of. Over.<end>
I'll see what I can do. Out.<end>
Maybe that old ferryman would be willing to help you. <end>
Having sec-troopers out of the camp at a moment like this is far too risky. <end>
It's too dangerous to go through the pirate territory.<end>
I've negotiated a deal with the pirates. You'll have to pay a toll, and there can't be any armed men on the boats, over.<end>
That sounds far too risky...<end>
They allowed me passage through their territory, over.<end>
If you say so. In that case I'll dispatch some laborers to the location you specified. <end>
Over.<end>
The area has been secured, but still be on the lookout for any creepers. The whole region is infested with them, over.<end>
Roger that. Dispatching units now. Out.<end>
Out.<end>
The whole region is infested with creepers, and so is the area where the mines are. Tell them to be on the lookout, over.<end>
The way to J1 is free. Don't you worry about the pirates, over.<end>
In that case I'll dispatch an armed transport to the location you specified. <end>
What do you propose I do, over?<end>
I've negotiated a deal with the pirates so we can get those mines. The conditions were that any passing boat has to pay a toll, and there can't carry any armed men, over.<end>
The way to J1 is pirate-free. Go and get those mines, over.<end>
::Channel 2 (Chief Briggs)::<end>
<end>
Briggs. ::You hear gunfire in the background.::<end>
<end>
You are all going to die.<end>
I need backup. Can you spare any troops to attack the pirates, over?<end>
Negative. We're pinned down. I repeat: Negative, we're pinned down.<end>
Lay low until we drive them away if you can; if not - you're on your own, soldier. Over.<end>
I found the professor. Need extraction, over.<end>
Negative. We're pinned down. Attempting extraction at this point would be too risky.<end>
Lay low until we drive them away or find your own way out. Over.<end>
What's your location, over?<end>
On a small island at E4, over.<end>
Affirmative. We'll be right there. Out.<end>
::Wait.::<end>
At G3, near the main entrance. The nearby enemies have been neutralized, over.<end>
At G3, near the main entrance. The nearby enemies have been neutralized, and I'm about to open the gate for you, over.<end>
I'll contact you as I find a suitable extraction point. Over.<end>
Affirmative, over.<end>
We've commenced the attack. Assist the sec-troops in locating and extracting the professor. Briggs out.<end>
Speak to me in person.<end>
Briggs.<end>
<end>
'Sup, Chief-o?<end>
We'll find you.<end>
Commence the attack on the pirates! Now!<end>
<end>
Affirmative. Out!<end>
I'm interested in the camp's security status, over.<end>
The situation is bad. There are only a handful of sec-troopers left defending the camp. <end>
Our firearm and ammunition supplies are <end>
very good, <end>
high-tech equipment supplies - <end>
very good, <end>
medical supplies - <end>
very good. <end>
<end>
Our jet ski numbers are very good.<end>
<end>
In addition to that we have lost<end>
Yahota.<end>
That is all, over.<end>
... some very good people.<end>
We have a sufficient number of jet skis left.<end>
We have lost a large number of jet skis.<end>
We barely have any jet skis left.<end>
satisfactory. <end>
running extremely low. <end>
almost non-existent. <end>
satisfactory, <end>
running extremely low, <end>
almost non-existent, <end>
satisfactory, <end>
quickly diminishing, <end>
almost non-existent, <end>
There are currently $(context.global_xpbl_aegisSecTroopersAvailable) sec-troopers defending the camp. <end>
::Channel 3 (Yahota)::<end>
<end>
I'm busy.<end>
You're dead.<end>
Not before I get the chance to shoot your nuts off, bastard.<end>
Not before I get the chance to blast that mug of yours to pieces, tart.<end>
Roger. Out.<end>
I'm in position.<end>
<end>
Remember me?<end>
I'm interested in enemy activity, over.<end>
<end>
::She answers coldly.:: <end>
<end>
The sea's looking calm at the moment. No enemy activity whatsoever. <end>
Over.<end>
There was something else I wanted to ask you, over.<end>
Go ahead, over.<end>
Thanks for the info. I'll leave you to your duty. Out.<end>
Pirates or savages?<end>
Pirates.<end>
<end>
The whole south-eastern part of the sea is pretty much dead. Barely any pirate activity there. <end>
Over.<end>
And the savages, over?<end>
<end>
Haven't noticed any activity lately. No moving lights, boats or anything of the sort. <end>
Over.<end>
And the pirates, over?<end>
Not much activity lately. Much fewer moving lights and boats as well. <end>
This might be the calm before the storm. <end>
Less activity than before the first attack, but still plenty. <end>
Still lots of activity. There's a lot of them there. <end>
Lots of activity there ever since we moved in. They are probably preparing for another attack. <end>
Not much activity over at the pirate base. Their patrols are becoming rather sparse as well. <end>
Lots of pirate jet ski patrols about. They could be up to something <end>
again<end>
. <end>
Savages.<end>
I need to speak to you in person. Where can I find you? Over.<end>
Not now.<end>
::Silence.::<end>
<end>
::She answers coldly.:: <end>
Negative. Use the navcom.<end>
And focus on the mission. <end>
Over.<end>
Top of the lighthouse in the camp.<end>
Can you see the Ferryman anywhere, over?<end>
::She answers coldly.:: <end>
No. He sailed north into savage territory before I lost sight of him. Should be in my scope again soon. <end>
He follows a fairly consistent route, visiting the mutie island and the pirate base before going north again. Over.<end>
Yes. He's docked at the <end>
pirate base. <end>
He's lying on the ground and doesn't appear to be moving. Looks fragged to me. Over.<end>
pier on the southern side of the mutie island. <end>
I need information on the pirate base. Over.<end>
You neutralized pretty much every fraggin' pirate. <end>
Locate the professor and carry out his extraction, over.<end>
They're well-armed, have lots of jet skis at their disposal - and hounds, lots of hounds walking about. <end>
Lots of fraggin' pirates here, that's for sure. <end>

From what I've been able to gather so far, there are three locations where Professor Oldfield is most probably being held at: The first is a derelict battleship in G2, right in the middle of their main base. Then there's a large heavily-defended building in E3. And then there's also that smaller base in I5, the one with the NFT lighthouse. There's a lot of activity there as well, which makes it another potential target.<end>
But for all we know the professor could be held anywhere. Maybe they even moved him somewhere deeper in the bay. Over.<end>
<end>
Tell me again about where you think the professor could be held at? Over.<end>
Got any specifics on their defenses? Over.<end>

High sheet metal walls around the base, with manned turrets at regular intervals. The southern entrance is the least defended one, but to get there you have to sneak through either G4 or H4, cross the bay undetected, and then enter the base from there. Plenty of jet ski patrols in the bay as well. Over.<end>
Armament? Over.<end>

Lots of firearms, explosive weapons, crossbows, machetes, sledgehammers and other melee weapons. Large-caliber, double-barreled turrets; no energy weapons noticed so far.
They also have hounds, pit bulls mostly. Was almost sniffed out by one of those mutts during my infiltration.
Over.<end>
What can you tell me about the battleship? Over.<end>

Appears to be one of those old Biocorp ships of war. There is a bridge which connects the main platform to the ship. Heavily guarded. If I were the captain of this rancid rabble, that's where I'd like my HQ to be. Over.<end>
What can you tell me about the large building in E3? Over.<end>

It's a two-story building. Purpose unknown. Multiple entrances. Lots of guards outside, and there are snipers on the rooftop. There are two ways to enter the area, east and south, and both require you to go through the main base. The western path leads up to a hill; it leads to the cliff where that glowing monolith is at. Over.<end>
What can you tell me about the lighthouse base? Over.<end>

Tall sheet metal walls. Jet ski dock at the entrance. Two large buildings, the taller of which is connected to the lighthouse via skyway. Actually, that's three buildings if we count the lighthouse as well. The main entrance is heavily guarded. But there is another entrance to the east. That's all I got. Over.<end>
That's all I needed to know. $(context.player.Name) out.<end>
Yahota out.<end>
<end>
What do you want to know about?<end>
I can see you.<end>
Too lazy to climb the lighthouse?<end>
Yeah?<end>
::Channel 4 (Professor Oldfield)::<end>
<end>
Yes? ::You hear gunfire in the background.:: Oldfield here. Who is this?<end>
Remember me, professor?<end>
With great disdain. Farewell, $(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName). May this sea be your grave.<end>
Are you okay, Professor?<end>
Yes, I'm fine, I'm fine. <end>
Don't worry about me. Best of luck. Out.<end>
I'd prefer it if we spoke in person. Oldfield out.<end>
Oldfield on the line. Over.<end>
<end>
I have a report to make about Nexus of Technology, over.<end>
It's you! May this sea be your grave.<end>
Yes, yes? Um... over.<end>
It is a large research facility... ::Explain to him what you discovered.::<end>

::After listening to you with great interest, only occasionally interjecting with various exclamations of surprise and awe, the professor shares his thoughts.::
Goodness me, that is marvelous indeed! Your descent down the elevator shaft, turning on the power, exploring the floors, all of it - truly incredible. And the fact that you managed to upgrade your microchip implant's clearance level with that... what did you say the device was called?<end>
Microchip encoder.<end>
Ah, yes - microchip encoder. That clearance level will certainly prove to be of great use, certainly. <end>
<end>
<end>
Excellent work, $(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName). <end>
See Marcus about your well-earned bonus when you come back. <end>
I'll contact you as soon as I have a new task for you. Best of luck. Oldfield out.<end>

The sec-chef, yes, the sec-chef is in charge of payments now. You'll find him in the camp's kitchen.
::It takes a moment for him to continue.:: He's... one of the few left alive, I'm afraid. <end>
See the sec-chef about your bonus when you come back. <end>
I have a report to make about Crimson Meadow Horticulture Center, over.<end>
Excellent. Do go on. Over.<end>
As the name says, it is a massive horticulture center... ::Explain to him what you discovered.::<end>

::You manage to convey the brooding atmosphere of the horticulture center so perfectly that the professor remains speechless for a good half a minute after you've finished speaking. He speaks after this pause.::
By the caverns, that is un-believable, $(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName). The vegetation, the insects, the pesticide... amazing, truly amazing. <end>
But one of the most important things is that you managed to find that dispatch console. They seem to be the key to discovering the locations of Lemurian facilities.<end>
<end>
It's... such a shame you couldn't explore the entire facility. Who knows what other incredible things you would've discovered?<end>
I have a report to make about Lemurian Health Center, over.<end>
Good work. I am all ears. Over.<end>
You are going to hear certain things that might be hard to believe... ::Explain to him what you discovered.::<end>

::The surreal nature of your visit to the Lemurian Health Center is difficult to express in mere words, but you do your best, and the professor follows your report with interest till the very end.::
I... don't know what to say, $(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName).<end>
You don't have to say anything.<end>
It might indeed be for the best.<end>
Let's just move on to me getting Phil's microchip implanted into my hand.<end>
Indeed we should, yes. Was there a reason why you did that?<end>
I needed it to access Joint Security headquarters. There was a scanner there which wouldn't let me pass without an implant in my hand.<end>
Ah, yes, I believe you mentioned it to me. <end>
I believe Doctor Savage can extract the implant for you.<end>
I'll keep that in mind, over.<end>
Yes, over, yes. <end>
In any case... <end>
<end>
I need it to access Joint Security headquarters. There is a scanner there which won't let me pass without an implant in my hand.<end>
I see... Very well then. <end>
I had a feeling I'd need that at some later point. Better do it while I'm there.<end>
I'll trust your judgement. <end>
You believe me, though, right?<end>
After being here for this long there's nothing I find hard to believe anymore, $(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName).<end>
I have a report to make about Joint Security Headquarters, over.<end>
I'm listening. Over.<end>
Well, after managing to pass that damned bioscan, I... ::Explain to him what you discovered.::<end>

::You report all your findings while the professor, as always, listens with great attentiveness.::
A rather sad ending for the Lemurian Security Command, I have to say. Goodness me, you stood in the same room from which Lemurian officers, fathers, sons and husbands observed their home being demolished by the Biocorp Undernavy.<end>
And now Biocorp is in ruins as well.<end>

Yes... Yes. It's an interesting parallel to make, as fifteen years ago Biocorp Armed Forces officers too were looking down at Protectorate invaders breaking into and causing havoc in Dis.
History tends to repeat itself, yet sadly it seems that with each iteration humanity loses more than it rebuilds, and some things are lost forever.<end>
But not everything. There was this dispatcher terminal at JSHQ. On it I found out about a transport vessel with a cargo id that read - *ACoNR*.<end>
Acorn? ::He takes off his glasses for a moment.:: Could it be? How large is it then if...?<end>
And it... it is at that Abyssal Station? Abyssal Station Zero.<end>
Seems so. The location is marked as Abyssal Station Zero Elevators.<end>

It's rather peculiar: This entire region has always been referred to as LEMCO, and we've not found a single instance of this Abyssal Station being mentioned.
Yet... if this station truly is abyssal, its depth could have saved it from Biocorp's detection.<end>

The Acorn... they sent it to a place they deemed the safest. They must've sent people too. If this station has remained intact for so long...
$(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName), there could still be someone down there.<end>
It's what NFT does best: Conquering the most inhospitable places.<end>
Precisely!<end>
This is your next destination, $(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName), Abyssal Station Zero. <end>
In case that these elevators are no longer functional, there is still that submarine you can try to use. Although... I fear whether it could endure the depths.<end>
See Marcus about your well-earned bonus when you come back. <end>
Best of luck, $(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName), best of luck. Oldfield out.<end>

The sec-chef, yes, the sec-chef is in charge of payments now. You'll find him in the camp's kitchen.
::It takes a moment for him to continue.:: He's... one of the few left alive, I'm afraid.<end>
See the sec-chef about your bonus when you come back. <end>
Hopefully those elevators still work. If not... There has to be another way. There has to be. <end>
Exactly. And from this station I've just returned.<end>
Goodness me... It's best that we discuss this in the camp. Come here as soon as you can. Out.<end>
Where... where was it taken? <end>
The location is marked as Abyssal Station Zero Elevators. It is somewhere in the southeastern bay.<end>
Abyssal Station Zero... <end>
To Abyssal Station Zero. From which I've just returned.<end>
Professor, there was a dispatcher terminal there. On it I found out about a transport vessel with a cargo id that read - *ACoNR*.<end>
I have a report to make about the Abyssal Station, over.<end>
You went down there?<end>
Yes I have.<end>
Excellent. <end>
Did you doubt me?<end>
Not at all, $(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName), not at all. <end>
Oh, did I.<end>
I've found a submarine at the Blistering Shores facility in the northeastern part of the sea, at L12. Over.<end>
Submarine? Oh, goodness me, that's quite a remarkable find. Shame it's so far away from here. How preserved is it, over?<end>
I don't think you understand. I believe it could still be used, even if not to its full capacity, over.<end>
Wait a minute, you mean an *actual* working submarine. By the caverns!<end>
A deep-diving submarine, from the looks of it, over.<end>
Remarkable! <end>
But this Abyssal Station you're talking about... It is something completely new to me.<end>
I found out about it in Joint Security Headquarters, after managing to pass that damned bioscan... ::Explain to him what you discovered.::<end>
This submarine, $(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName), it could be the last part of the puzzle. If the Acorn truly is down there, at this Abyssal Station...<end>
The only question which remains is: Will this submarine actually work?<end>
There's only one way to find out.<end>
Well, best of luck, $(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName). <end>

You may become the first $(#man/woman) in two centuries to dive in a Lemurian submarine.
If you need anything, contact me. We're getting so close...<end>
I haven't seen any holes.<end>
Leave it to me, professor. I'll make it work.<end>
I don't know.<end>
This would certainly open a new way for us to access these facilities. There would be no need to traverse dangerous waters, but we can instead sail below the surface.<end>
When I deliver, I deliver, over.<end>
I don't think you understand. It's a functional submarine. It's damaged and cannot be used to its full capacity, but it has an auto-pilot I may be able to activate, over.<end>

I don't think you understand. It's a functional submarine. It's damaged and cannot be used to its full capacity, but I've found a way to activate its auto-pilot. I've located this Abyssal Station Zero in the southeastern bay, and that's where I'll be diving, over.<end>
Mind answering a couple of questions not related to my current mission?<end>
You mean, over navcom? We better discuss these things in person, $(context.npc_xpbl_oldfield_playerName).<end>
See me when you return to the camp and I'll be happy to answer any questions you may have. Over.<end>
Where are you right now, professor, at the Keep or in your tent? Over.<end>
I'm in my tent, over.<end>
I'm in the Arch Island Keep, over.<end>
::Channel 5 (Doctor Savage)::<end>
<end>
::You hear a sigh.:: Just talk to me. Out.<end>
Mmm? Savage speaking.<end>
<end>
Doc, the muties want some of our medicine in exchange for letting me search for the microchip implant. I have a list of the medication they need, over.<end>
<end>
::He sighs.::<end>

::He answers with a delay.::
Does Chief know about this?<end>
::[Persuade]:: No. But you tell him that unless I appease these muties somehow their island's going to turn into a war zone and he's never going to get that implant.<end>
::He sighs.:: <end>
I see your point...<end>
::Silence.::<end>
::He sighs.:: Alright, alright. Read me the list.<end>
They need... ::Read the list.::<end>
::You wait for Doc's response after reading him the list.::<end>
That's quite a list.<end>
Yes. I'm short on time, you know.<end>
You do realize that is going out of our *actual* supplies? Not Union Resources or... I don't know what you have here in South Underrail. This will affect us. More for them means less for us.<end>
<end>
There's no other option.<end>

Hm.
I can't give them everything they need. That's... just ludicrous. I'll check my inventory and see what I can do.<end>
Thanks. Can someone bring it over?<end>
Yes. I'll send someone over. ::He sighs.:: Savage out.<end>
::Wait for the supplies to arrive.::<end>
::Wait for the supplies to arrive.::<end>
Well, when you put it that way...<end>
So?<end>
Forget about it. I'll figure something out.<end>
Is that everything?<end>
Come on, Doc, can't we spare at least something?<end>
Damn it...<end>

No, no. Sorry, $(context.player.Name), but I can't help you. I can't afford to be wasting resources. And Chief Briggs...
Just forget about it, okay?<end>
Doc...<end>
Stop.<end>
Now, was there anything else you needed or...?<end>
Well, damn.<end>
Yes. He told me to contact you.<end>
Doc, we need to send some of our medical supplies to the muties, over.<end>
Why? We already have the implant.<end>
I promised them.<end>
I can't help you. We have the implant already and can't afford to be wasting resources.<end>
They need it, Doc.<end>
Stop asking questions and work with me here.<end>
About those supplies for the muties...<end>
::He sighs.:: We already have the implant. Why are we talking about this?<end>
Doc, could you possibly implant a microchip into my hand, over?<end>
Are you... out of your mind? You want to put... Wait, what implant? NFT's?<end>

::[Intelligence]:: Yes. I can't get past a bioscanning chamber at the military base to the north, and it has to be because I'm using the arm, yet without the arm I can't get authorized. So maybe if I implant the chip in my own hand I'll be able to pass the scan. Over.<end>
Uh... I'm not following you at all, but I still can't do that. <end>
I don't have the proper tools, and not to mention all the other risks I see with a procedure like that in these conditions.<end>

But if you still find a way to do it... ::He sighs.:: I got an extraction tool I use for... Oh, what do you even care.
If you get yourself an implant, I can get it out. Over.<end>
Yes. I can't get past a bioscanning chamber at the military base to the north. Maybe if I put that thing in my hand I'll be able to. Over.<end>
Sorry, $(context.player.Name), but I can't do that. <end>
::He sighs.:: What?<end>

::[Intelligence]:: I can't get past a bioscanning chamber at the military base to the north, and it has to be because I'm using the arm, yet without the arm I can't get authorized. So maybe if I implant the chip in my own hand I'll be able to pass the scan. Over.<end>
I can't get past a bioscanning chamber at the military base to the north. Maybe if I put that thing in my hand I'll be able to, over.<end>
Heya, Doc. How's the addiction?<end>
::Channel 6 (Recovery Team Alfa)::<end>
This is RTA leader speaking, over.<end>
<end>
Remember me?<end>

It's you, isn't it?
We're gonna get you, treacherous bastard.<end>
Report. Over.<end>
<end>
<end>
<end>
We're holding position, over. ::You hear gunfire in the background.:: Eat this! ::Gunfire continues.::<end>
We're... we're low on men... ::You hear gunfire in the background.:: There are so many... ::Gunfire continues.::<end>
We're in the camp. Over.<end>
<end>
We've been ambushed by a giant hermit crab. Neutralized it before it could get close. This one was hiding in an NFT crate. Be on the lookout. <end>
Resuming mission, over.<end>

We recently engaged giant insects capable of long-ranged attacks. They live in three to four meters tall hives and are highly defensive. We're trying to avoid these hives as much as possible but there is simply too many of them. <end>
We engaged a group of natives. Neutralized one, the rest retreated. No casualties on our sides. <end>

Nothing t--
::You hear loud screeching followed by silence.::<end>
Everything's okay. Your voice disturbed some bats. We have nothing new to report. <end>
Nothing new to report. <end>
We're on the move. Over.<end>
::Channel 7 (Camp security)::<end>
Wilson here, over.<end>
<end>
What's your status? Over.<end>
No hostiles in sight. Ready to move out, over.<end>
<end>
::He answers after a pause.:: It's just me here. Everything's calm. Over.<end>
